_comment: Gancio instances (https://gancio.org) - self-hosted AGPL event software used by social centres, DIY venues and neighbourhood collectives. One URL pattern, no key: {base}/api/events?start=<unix>&end=<unix>&max=<n>. Almost every event carries place.latitude/longitude, so these need no geocoding. Gancio's stock robots.txt allows everything, with no crawl-delay, but an operator can replace it: vagancio.partidopirata.com.ar serves `User-agent: *` / `Disallow: /` (2026-10-04). The API is read under DOCUMENTED_API_TYPES either way, as the Mobilizon instances with the same file are; an operator who asks is taken off (README, Conduct). The 2s here is politeness toward volunteer-run servers, several on home connections. default_city/region/country only fill gaps - Gancio's own place.address is used when present. There is no public directory API (gancio.org/instances is HTML), so this list is seeded by hand; add instances as they are verified.

sites.name: RheinMain (DE)
sites._note: rheinmain.social and fomo.rheinmain.social both redirect to events.rheinmain.social (301 and 302, 2026-10-24): one calendar. Kept once, under the vaguer community default, since it is a mixed culture calendar (Kreativfabrik and Schlachthof Wiesbaden, NAXOS Frankfurt, Mainz and Darmstadt collectives; many concerts, which the classifier promotes).

sites.name: Akce nolog.cz (Czech community and activist calendar)
sites._note: Czech Gancio instance with 25 upcoming events (20 carry coordinates) in Prague, Brno and Bratislava community spaces: swaps, book clubs, a weekly trans/enby chat, a game jam and Critical Mass rides. The benefits are free or donation-based. devent.cz federates every event here but without coordinates (0 of 49 on 2026-10-04), and the sync geocodes only US addresses, so this origin is what places them (20 of 25). Listed before Devent (CZ) so a row's first link is the organiser's own page. Not a duplicate.

sites.name: Calendari.cc (Valencia)
sites._note: Gancio instance: libertarian/social-centre agenda for Valencia (casals, ateneus, assemblies, free classes); robots.txt allows /api. Fills Valencia's grassroots gap.

sites.name: Agenda Henares (Alcalá de Henares)
sites._note: Gancio instance: self-managed activist and cultural agenda for the Henares valley (Madrid region); robots.txt allows /api. Free workshops, language exchanges, family play groups.

sites.name: Enredad (Spain)
sites._note: Gancio instance: queer, feminist and racialised community events across Spain (Madrid, Barcelona, Málaga, Murcia...); robots.txt allows /api. Most events carry coordinates.

sites.name: Convoca Málaga (ES)
sites._note: Gancio instance (convoca.la network): self-managed social and cultural agenda for Málaga; robots.txt allows /api. Sibling of the configured bcn/mad instances.

sites.name: Convoca Tramuntana (Girona)
sites._note: Gancio instance (convoca.la network): social-movement agenda for the Girona counties; robots.txt allows /api. Tenant assemblies, talks, community sport.

sites.name: Convoca Eivissa i Formentera (ES)
sites._note: Gancio instance (convoca.la network): community agenda for Ibiza and Formentera; robots.txt allows /api. Community garden open days, second-hand markets.

sites.name: event.cologne (Cologne)
sites._note: Gancio instance for Cologne: city libraries, Rathaus science talks, botanic-garden tours, Hänneschen, Karneval; 426 events in 180 days, 207 tagged EintrittFrei, 96% with coordinates. robots.txt allows all.

sites.name: Wedel Veranstaltungen (Wedel, Hamburg metro)
sites._note: Gancio calendar for Wedel (Pinneberg district, Hamburg metro): VHS talks and courses, sustainability series, DRK meeting centre, church events, excursions; 509 events in 180 days, all with coordinates. robots.txt allows all.

sites.name: Fahrradtermine Berlin
sites._note: Gancio calendar of Berlin cycling groups: ADFC and Changing Cities district groups, bike demos, Critical Mass, self-help bike workshop; 40 upcoming, 25 with coordinates (online ones drop). robots.txt allows all.

sites.name: Sprachtreffen.de (language cafés)
sites._note: Gancio listing free language cafés and tandem meetups in neighbourhood centres and libraries, about a third in Berlin, the rest across DE/AT/CH; 92 upcoming, 45 with coordinates. robots.txt allows all.

sites.name: Laboratório Hacker de Campinas (Campinas, Brazil)
sites._note: The hackerspace's own Gancio, with 16 upcoming events. 11 are at the space (Rua Araribóia 121): a Rust course, open coworking days, CoffeeOps talks, a Home Assistant community day and the 15th-birthday barbecue. 3 are online council meetings.

sites.name: Botep - Bergamo social centres (Bergamo, Italy)
sites._note: Gancio instance for Bergamo's social centres and circoli. 2026-10-23, production UA, 180-day window: 37 upcoming events, 34 with place.latitude/longitude (all inside lat 45.67-45.84, lon 9.54-9.72), at Club Ricreativo Pignolo, CSA Paci Paciana, Circolino della Malpensata. Titles: open mic, concerts, recycling and textile workshops (laboratorio), Critical Mass, benefit dinners, a student presidio. Mixed, so community. robots.txt Allow: /.

sites.name: aleale - agenda alternative de Montpellier (Montpellier, France)
sites._note: Gancio instance for Montpellier associations. 2026-10-23: 30 upcoming, 29 with coordinates (Montpellier/Frontignan). Food-recovery rounds (Récup' alimentaire AJAP, twice weekly), collective gardening at Agropolis, hackerspace drop-in, self-defence workshops, choir, film debates, an associative grocery; also a few demonstrations (Manifestation ... Acte II). Mixed, so community. robots.txt Allow: /.

sites.name: Convoca Roma (Rome, Italy)
sites._note: The Rome node of the convoca.la Gancio family (Barcelona, Madrid, Malaga, Girona, Eivissa already configured). 2026-10-23: 26 upcoming, 17 with coordinates inside Rome/Fiumicino. Organic market in Certosa, second-hand market (riusa rigenera ripara), free chess course, a mountain hike, burraco tournament, Critical Mass, social-centre concerts. community. robots.txt Allow: /.

sites.name: Balotta - Bologna community agenda (Bologna, Italy)
sites._note: Gancio instance for Bologna's self-run spaces. 2026-10-23: 58 upcoming, only 18 with coordinates (31%; the rest have an address but no point, and the sync places nothing outside the US without one). Mostly DIY concerts (tag musica 17), plus a popular food store (Spaccio Popolare Autogestito), hack meetups, theatre, chess. Mixed, so community. Overlap with the configured opendata.comune.bologna.it cultural agenda is unlikely (grassroots venues), not measured. robots.txt Allow: /.

sites.name: Convoca Mallorca (Palma, Spain)
sites._note: convoca.la Gancio node for Mallorca. 2026-10-23: 14 upcoming, 11 with coordinates (Palma, Felanitx, Pollenca). Catalan conversation groups, book club, glosa (improvised verse) workshop, local seed-planting workshop, writing workshop, open assemblies at Ateneu Popular La Fonera. community. robots.txt Allow: /.

sites.name: Flying High Bonn - linke Termine (Bonn, Germany)
sites._note: Gancio instance for Bonn. Not a copy of the configured bonn.jetzt: 1 of 31 title+start pairs shared (2026-10-23). 31 upcoming, 29 with coordinates (Kult 41, Alte VHS, Oscar-Romero-Haus). Book club, juggling, dice tournament, open art space for autistic people, a homelessness city walk, choir, improv, concerts; 5 are open plenaries of political groups. Mixed, so community. robots.txt Allow: /.

_not_included.https://vagancio.partidopirata.com.ar: Vagancio - agenda autogestiva (Buenos Aires / La Plata) - a Gancio instance's /api/events. RETIRED 2026-10-05 under the owner's instruction to keep only working and compliant sources (2026-10-05): https://vagancio.partidopirata.com.ar/robots.txt answers `Disallow: /` to every crawler (`User-agent: *`). That is the operator's own file: Gancio's stock robots.txt allows crawling, and 25 of the 26 configured instances answered with no such line on 2026-10-05. It had been read under DOCUMENTED_API_TYPES (the 2026-09-30 API line); an operator who refuses every crawler is now taken at its word. To restore: once its robots.txt lets MapseeAggregator in, or the operator says yes, copy the entry back from gancio_sources.json at 1fbdfaa; `verify` will then pass it.
_not_included.https://fomo.rheinmain.social: Retired 2026-10-24: the same calendar as the configured rheinmain.social. Both hosts redirect to events.rheinmain.social, and 145 of 145 title+start pairs were identical on 2026-10-23, so every event reached the map twice under two source_ids (the adapter keys rows on base_url).
